title: Applicability boundaries of NMF detrital-zircon unmixing — reproducibility package
description: Code and data accompanying Pan, L., "Where does detrital-zircon source unmixing break? An analytic identifiability criterion and its large-scale Monte-Carlo verification for NMF provenance unmixing" (submitted to Sedimentary Geology). Reproduces every figure: the synthetic data generator, the HPC scan harness (supervised and unsupervised KL-NMF), the merge and figure-generation scripts, the identifiability-theory verification scripts (direct sigma_err measurement on the (rho, n) plane) and their bias/RMSE decomposition, the per-axis results, the per-cell 3D phase-atlas summary, and the real-sample a-priori screen (Fig. 8) with fifteen real per-grain detrital-zircon age samples (Cretaceous Songliao Basin; Jurassic-Lower Cretaceous northern North China Craton margin). Code and synthetic results: MIT licence. The real age samples are redistributed under their original CC BY 4.0 licences (OneDZ, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15522949; Puetz et al., Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.24852987.v1) with per-sample attribution; they are not re-licensed as MIT. v1.2.1 adds selected supplementary numerical probes, small historical summaries, atlas generator/HPC wrapper/merge, explicit Fig.3 command and seed verification, BU21 bibliography, and the submitted-a Fig.1 label, source-verified real-sample record corrections (05FW007; 100821-1/-3) with a re-rendered Fig. 8, conditional in-figure wording for Figs 3 and 8, and verified dataset licences. Historical probe comments describe exploratory models; theory_checks/README.md states their current scope and verification limits. The full per-seed atlas raw (559 MB; 187 MB gzipped) is not included. No separate public archive DOI was found in the project records searched; these raw data are not publicly archived in a verified record and may be requested from the author.
